timing.note: Each reported train_seconds is the same full fit repeated in checkpoint/GEN rows and is counted once, never multiplied by evaluations.

caveats: TRAIN4817 is reused for adaptive selection; TRAIN5817 only confirms a frozen recipe.
Two GEN seeds do not increase independent training N.
Full50k is a scope audit of seed4817 checkpoints, not a new TRAIN repetition or untouched test.
Final exposure is chosen from about8.50,10.62,12.75epochs under measured throughput; no128epoch optimum is proven.

final_budget_rule.rule: Highest shared exposure fitting measured two-TRAIN fit and24 final evaluations plus15% margin; full50k reserve=max20min or measured4GEN cost x1.25. If none fit, attempt minimum with explicit deadline risk. Two TRAIN seeds outrank higher exposure.

controller_frozen_selection.runtime_comparability: Inherited TRAIN4817 control manual-GC128; remaining runs no manual GC. Same objective/model/data/seed/budget, runtime differs; explicitly disclose.

figures.scope: Verified actual completed stages only; missing stages not padded

full50000.aggregation: Equal GEN means within TRAIN4817; fullset audit only, not independent training confirmation
